issue: Discovery sweep surfaced the long-planned relocation of the Piombino FSRU vessel (Italis LNG, ex-Golar Tundra) ~8 km off Vado Ligure / Savona (Liguria) for a 17-year deployment. This is NOT a new GEM terminal: the proposed Ligurian site is the relocation destination of the existing Piombino unit, and a separate 'Vado Ligure LNG terminal' record should NOT be created. Status has shifted materially since the export's anchor: ARERA Resolution 88/2025/R/GAS (11 Mar 2025) rejected the Piombino->Vado Ligure transfer as too costly, and as of Mar 2026 the Italian government (DL 11 Mar 2026, Gazzetta Ufficiale) confirmed the FSRU will remain at Piombino; Snam has requested an extension of the Piombino single authorization (Autorizzazione Unica), which currently expires Jul 2026. The relocation should be reflected on the Piombino FSRU timeline/notes (planned move shelved/rejected, not executed) rather than left implying an imminent 2026 move.
suggested_action: Route to an Update batch for the Piombino FSRU row: record that the Vado Ligure/Savona relocation was rejected by ARERA (Res. 88/2025, Mar 2025) and that as of Mar 2026 the vessel is confirmed to remain at Piombino with Snam seeking an authorization extension (current auth expires Jul 2026). Do NOT stage a new Vado Ligure terminal. fetch_timeline is DOWN this batch, so the existing status timeline could not be pulled to stage the change directly. Sources: https://www.ilpost.it/2026/03/15/rigassificatore-rimarra-piombino/ ; https://www.ivg.it/2026/01/rigassificatore-lex-golar-tundra-potrebbe-restare-a-piombino-snam-chiede-la-proroga-dellautorizzazione/
